title: OpenPanel · Revenue
description: Gross recorded revenue, before refunds, taxes, fees or FX. OpenPanel v2 stores nonnegative integer minor units. Include a currency property with every revenue event. A backend must deduplicate payment webhooks before sending.

panels.title: Gross revenue · minor units
panels.description: EUR/USD cents; JPY yen. Kept in minor units to avoid incorrect currency-decimal assumptions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(revenue) AS GrossMinorUnits FROM `${database:raw}`.events WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND $__conditionalAll(project_id IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND name = 'revenue' AND if(empty(properties['currency']), 'UNSPECIFIED', upper(properties['currency'])) = ${currency:singlequote}

panels.title: Recorded payment events
panels.description: Not guaranteed unique orders. Event IDs and order IDs are not a payment ledger.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS PaymentEvents FROM `${database:raw}`.events WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND $__conditionalAll(project_id IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND name = 'revenue' AND if(empty(properties['currency']), 'UNSPECIFIED', upper(properties['currency'])) = ${currency:singlequote}

panels.title: Gross revenue over time · minor units

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(created_at) AS time, sum(revenue) AS GrossMinorUnits FROM `${database:raw}`.events WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND $__conditionalAll(project_id IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND name = 'revenue' AND if(empty(properties['currency']), 'UNSPECIFIED', upper(properties['currency'])) = ${currency:singlequote} GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT project_id AS Project, sum(revenue) AS GrossMinorUnits, count() AS PaymentEvents FROM `${database:raw}`.events WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND $__conditionalAll(project_id IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND name = 'revenue' AND if(empty(properties['currency']), 'UNSPECIFIED', upper(properties['currency'])) = ${currency:singlequote} GROUP BY Project ORDER BY GrossMinorUnits DESC

panels.title: Currency coverage
panels.description: Amounts are grouped by currency and must not be added across rows. UNSPECIFIED needs instrumentation fixes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(empty(properties['currency']), 'UNSPECIFIED', upper(properties['currency'])) AS Currency, count() AS PaymentEvents, sum(revenue) AS GrossMinorUnits FROM `${database:raw}`.events WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND $__conditionalAll(project_id IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND name = 'revenue' GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY PaymentEvents DESC

list.name: database
list.label: Database
list.query: SELECT database FROM system.tables WHERE name IN ('events', 'sessions') AND match(database, '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$') GROUP BY database HAVING countDistinct(name) = 2 ORDER BY database
list.definition: SELECT database FROM system.tables WHERE name IN ('events', 'sessions') AND match(database, '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$') GROUP BY database HAVING countDistinct(name) = 2 ORDER BY database

list.label: Project ID
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_id FROM `${database:raw}`.events ORDER BY project_id
